column1: # Random cells of the string, byte and bit operators, held out: the rules were worked out before these cells were run.
# Columns: operator, type of a, value of a, type of b, value of b, expected result of "a <operator> b" (T or F, or
# DUMP:<runtime error> for a runtime error that cannot be caught), expected sy-fdpos afterwards (- if the expression
# does not set it). IS INITIAL has a single operand.
# Operands are set as in comparison.tsv: a c, n, d or t holds exactly the characters given, padded with blanks; any
# other type gets the given text converted to it (x and xstring as hex digits). The operands are data objects whose
# type is known at run time only (generic parameters). With static types the cells marked DUMP:... are syntax errors.
# No cell has a CP or NP pattern ending in a # that escapes nothing.
